question: Show all retailers
sql: SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users AS u WHERE u.user_role = 2 LIMIT 100

question: Generate a table of retailers linked to distributor 5997
sql: SELECT u.id AS retailer_id, u.name AS retailer_name FROM retailer_distributor_mappings AS rdm JOIN users AS u ON rdm.retailer_id = u.id WHERE rdm.distributor_id = 5997 AND u.user_role = 2 LIMIT 100

question: Show total wallet amount for July 2026
sql: SELECT SUM(wt.amount) AS total_wallet_amount FROM wallet_transaction AS wt WHERE wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND wt.amount > 0 AND wt.transaction_type = 1

question: Compare total wallet transactions between July and June 2026
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' THEN wt.amount ELSE 0 END) AS july_total, SUM(CASE WHEN wt.created_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00' THEN wt.amount ELSE 0 END) AS june_total FROM wallet_transaction AS wt WHERE wt.amount > 0

question: Show top 10 retailers by earnings for July 2026
sql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.mobile_number, SUM(wt.amount) AS total_earning FROM users AS u JOIN wallet_transaction AS wt ON u.id = wt.user_id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND wt.amount > 0 AND wt.reference_type IN ('cash_point', 'topup', 'redeem_coupon', 'incentive', 'bonus_conversion', 'referral_earning') AND wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.mobile_number ORDER BY total_earning DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which distributor has the highest number of box scans this month?
sql: SELECT u.id AS distributor_id, u.name AS distributor_name, COUNT(si.id) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories AS si JOIN users AS u ON si.distributer_id = u.id WHERE u.user_role = 4 AND NOT si.retailer_scanned_at IS NULL AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which retailer under which distributor has scanned the highest number of boxes this month?
sql: SELECT r.id AS retailer_id, r.name AS retailer_name, d.id AS distributor_id, d.name AS distributor_name, COUNT(si.id) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories AS si JOIN retailer_distributor_mappings AS rdm ON si.status_retailer_id = rdm.retailer_id JOIN users AS r ON rdm.retailer_id = r.id AND r.user_role = 2 AND r.status = 'approved' JOIN users AS d ON rdm.distributor_id = d.id AND d.user_role = 4 AND d.status = 'approved' WHERE NOT si.retailer_scanned_at IS NULL AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY r.id, r.name, d.id, d.name ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which state has the highest number of box scans this month?
sql: SELECT u.state_id, COUNT(si.id) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories AS si JOIN users AS u ON si.status_retailer_id = u.id WHERE NOT si.retailer_scanned_at IS NULL AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.state_id ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which category has the highest number of box scans this month?
sql: SELECT si.sku_description AS category, COUNT(*) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories AS si WHERE NOT si.retailer_scanned_at IS NULL AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY si.sku_description ORDER BY box_scan_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which category has the lowest number of box scans this month, and which state has the lowest number of box scans?
sql: SELECT si.sku_description, COUNT(si.id) AS box_scan_count FROM sku_inventories AS si WHERE NOT si.retailer_scanned_at IS NULL AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY si.sku_description ORDER BY box_scan_count ASC LIMIT 1
